# Left green is at [30-32, 18-20], center at [31, 19]

    if b != a:
        diffs = [(j, b[j], a[j]) for j in range(min(len(b), len(a))) if b[j] != a[j]]
        if diffs:
            print(f"  Row {i}: {diffs}")

# Check current green positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        for cid in n['children']:
            c = next((x for x in seg['nodes'] if x['id'] == cid), None)
            if c:
                print(f"Green at {n['boundary']}, center={c['color']}")
